mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads item group ITEM_ETC number i from Book{i+1:02}.bmd, so number 12 is Book13.bmd; MuMain's ZzzInfomation.cpp:434 has ITEM_SCROLL_OF_COMETFALL teach AT_SKILL_BLAST, and OpenMU's Version095d/Items/Scrolls.cs:31 names group 15 number 12 the Scroll of Cometfall. 0.95d's and not 0.75's: 0.75 has no Cometfall.
why_this_one: The user, 2026-10-05: 'lets migrate Cometfall, which is soul master spell, it has to be same famulity as meteor but of course stronger', after the audit of what Tarkan and Blood Castle 6 drop and this game had not built. Drop level 80: Tarkan's Iron Wheel and everything past it, and Blood Castle 6's Chief Skeleton Archer and past him (sim/skills.cpp).
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Book01.bmd through Book19.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- Book13.bmd's md5 is Book01's, addf8a7d -- so this names the one the pipeline has built, as Book02 through Book16 do.

stats.note: A scroll's row, in the shape of Book01's, at 0.95d's numbers.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version095d/Items/Scrolls.cs:31, CreateScroll(12, 13, "Scroll of Cometfall", 80, 0, 436, 175000); WebZen 1.00m's item(Kor).txt row 15/12 agrees on the drop level 80.
stats.classes_gladiator: The Magic Gladiator's too: MuMain's Data/Local/item.bmd marks it in RequireClass[3], his column (docs/mg-port.md).
stats.classes_from: QualifiedCharacters.Add(DarkWizard) in CreateScroll (Version095d adds the Magic Gladiator, who is not in this game). Prize.ReadBy refuses the other two. The user calls it the Soul Master's; MU lets any wizard read it, and so does this.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches, and nothing here reads it. See Book01, which carries the argument for recording it and the two rules attached to these numbers - the requirement is not scaled, and the value is the price outright.
skill.name: Cometfall
skill.tells: With his arm raised to the sky he calls blue comets down on the ground up to nine tiles off, falling at random within four tiles of it.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the scroll's tooltip and the skill's card say the same thing.
skill.energy_from: Version095d/SkillsInitializer.cs:57 and Scrolls.cs:31 both: 436, the skill's own, carried raw as Inferno's 578 is (docs/mu-scrolls-and-orbs.md SS4).
skill.level_from: Ours: about twice the scroll's drop level, in MU's own order (the user's audit of 2026-10-02: 'currently chars can get end game scroll and orbs pretty fast, remember we have 100% exp rate'), between Aqua Beam's 148 and Inferno's 176. The energy MU asks is kept beside it.
